events.description: Completed the acquisition of 360 Park Avenue South in New York City on December 14, 2021, for a gross purchase price of approximately $300.7 million. The consideration consisted of the assumption of approximately $200.3 million of mortgage debt and the issuance of 866,503 common units of limited partnership interest in BPLP (OP Units) valued at approximately $99.7 million.
events.source_quote: On December 14, 2021, we completed the acquisition of 360 Park Avenue South, an approximately 450,000 square-foot, 20-story Class A office property located in the Midtown South submarket of Manhattan. The gross purchase price, including transaction costs, was approximately $300.7 million and consisted of (1) the assumption of approximately $200.3 million of mortgage debt collateralized by the property and (2) the issuance of approximately 866,503 common units of limited partnership interest in BPLP (“OP Units”).

events.description: Entered into a joint venture on September 1, 2021, to acquire Safeco Plaza, a 50-story Class A office property in Seattle, Washington, for a net purchase price of approximately $460.1 million, including $4.9 million of seller-funded leasing and capital costs. BXP invested approximately $72.6 million for its 33.67% interest in the joint venture, with the remainder funded by two institutional partners and a new $250.0 million mortgage loan maturing in 2026.
events.source_quote: On September 1, 2021, we entered into a joint venture to acquire Safeco Plaza, a Class A office property located in Seattle, Washington, for a net purchase price of approximately $460.1 million, including $4.9 million of seller-funded leasing and capital costs. Safeco Plaza is a 50-story, approximately 765,000 net rentable square-foot, Class A office property. The acquisition was completed through a newly formed joint venture with two institutional partners.

events.description: Redeemed all 80,000 outstanding shares of 5.25% Series B Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock and corresponding Depositary Shares on April 1, 2021, for a total cash redemption price of approximately $201.3 million, including approximately $1.3 million of accrued and unpaid dividends, resulting in a preferred stock redemption charge of approximately $6.4 million representing original issuance costs.
events.source_quote: On April 1, 2021, BXP redeemed 80,000 shares of Series B Preferred Stock (including the corresponding 8,000,000 Depositary Shares), which represented all of the outstanding shares of Series B Preferred Stock and all of the outstanding Depositary Shares. In connection with the redemption of the Series B Preferred Stock, all of the Series B Preferred Units, which had terms and preferences generally mirroring those of the Series B Preferred Stock, were redeemed by BPLP.

events.description: BPLP completed the early redemption of $1.0 billion in aggregate principal amount of its 3.85% senior notes due February 1, 2023, on October 15, 2021, using proceeds from its September 2021 offering of unsecured senior notes and borrowings under its 2021 Credit Facility. Excluding accrued interest, the redemption price was approximately 104.284% of the principal amount, resulting in an early extinguishment loss of approximately $44.2 million.
events.source_quote: On October 15, 2021, BPLP used proceeds from its September 2021 offering of unsecured senior notes and borrowings under its 2021 Credit Facility to complete the redemption of $1.0 billion in aggregate principal amount of its 3.85% senior notes due February 1, 2023. The redemption price was approximately $1.05 billion.

events.description: Amended the ground lease at Sumner Square in Washington, DC on May 19, 2021, to extend the lease term for an additional 15 years through August 9, 2081. Under the terms of the amendment, BXP paid $23.0 million of rent on July 1, 2021, and committed to fund approximately $4.0 million for the operation and maintenance of the Sumner School over the next five years.
events.source_quote: On May 19, 2021, we amended the ground lease at Sumner Square in Washington, DC to extend the term for an additional 15 years. Prior to the amendment, the ground lease was scheduled to expire on August 10, 2066. The ground lease will now expire on August 9, 2081. The amended lease required us to pay $23.0 million of rent in 2021 and requires our remaining obligation of approximately $4.0 million be used to fund certain operation and maintenance costs incurred by the government with respect to the Sumner School for the next five years, with no payments thereafter.
